description: This file contains implementation of various tensor fill operations optimized for Apple Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) backend within the PyTorch project. It defines functions for filling tensors with scalar or tensor values, including handling complex types, and utilizes caching for MPS graphs.

classes.name: CachedGraph
classes.description: A cache structure for MPS graphs used to optimize repeated fill operations

methods.name: fill_scalar_mps_impl
methods.description: Implements scalar fill operation on a tensor, handling cache and graph execution.

methods.name: fill_mps_tensor_
methods.description: Fills a tensor with a byte value directly through the MPS stream when the tensor is contiguous.

methods.name: fill_scalar_mps
methods.description: Fills a tensor with a scalar value, with special handling for complex types and contiguous tensors.

methods.name: fill_tensor_mps_
methods.description: Fills a tensor with a zero or scalar tensor value.
